text: みんな　レッドの　ファンを　やめちゃった　のね　でも　これで　レッドの　こと　わたしが　ひとりじめ　できるのね　わーい！

structure.jp: みんな　レッドの　ファンを　やめちゃった　のね
structure.en: so everyone has quit being Red's fan

structure.jp: わたしが　ひとりじめ　できるのね
structure.en: I can have all to myself

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃった is the short spoken form of てしまった, which says the thing happened completely. やめちゃった = 'they went and quit'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: やめちゃった　のね
patterns.explanation: の at the end shows she is taking in a fact she has just understood; this soft の alone is how women and girls often say it. やめちゃった　のね = 'so they've quit, I see'

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a person means that person and everything about them, and is common when talking about feelings toward someone. レッドの　こと = 'Red'
